COP2000.title: Introduction to Computer Programming
COP2000.prerequisites: None statewide; written for students with no programming background. IRSC recommends MAT 1033 (Intermediate Algebra). FAU's COP 2000 is an honors course in the Wilkes Honors College. *** SAME COURSE AS COP 1000: SCNS equivalency is set by the prefix and the last three digits, so COP 1000 and COP 2000 share the statewide record COP x000 and transfer as one course; COP 1000C is the same course with an integrated lab. *** The language (Python, C++, Java, C#) varies by college, so ask before you register. *** For a computer-science bachelor's, check the university's own entry course: at FAU it is COP 2220C, a different number, so the transfer is evaluated rather than guaranteed.

offering_notes.summary: Five Florida public carriers, all at 3 credits. Only FAU publishes contact hours (3 lecture hours a week).
offering_notes.derivation: FAU publishes 3 weekly lecture hours (45 a semester); the four state colleges publish none, and Florida's convention for a 3-credit lecture course gives the same 45.
